author: HandheldGaymer
quote: The glazing of GTA VI is off the charts. I’m about 10 hours in and I don’t think I have it in me to go further. I can’t believe I made it past that unbelievable slog of a prologue. Just kept thinking there would eventually be more to the story and gameplay than worshipping and simping for Lucia. Worst than the story and framerate issue is the fact that the game is low key misandrist and racist against whites. This game is a Trojan horse of evil, including such gifts as getting us used to a digital only world, normalizing racism, and learning to allow one’s partner to be completely abusive. Yeah, 10 hours and $80 I’ll never get back, I’m for sure done with this and really encourage you to spend your money and time in more fun and productive ways.

author: HandheldGaymer
quote: Easily the best game on PS4 yet. Gorgeous graphics throughout the entire game and intuitive controls make Second Son a must-have for PlayStation owners. I wish the story would've dug deeper in a few instances, but it was never that big of a deal because I was having too much fun trying out kick-ass superpowers in a pretty good recreation of Seattle (where I live). Fingers crossed for DLC content soon.

author: HandheldGaymer
quote: Resogun is crack. Plain and simple. Gameplay is intense and sufficiently challenging, with the boss levels being extra difficult. Online co-op is a blast as well. The visuals, however, have stuck with me all weekend long, even when I'm not playing the game. Best launch title, IMHO.

author: HandheldGaymer
quote: Easily the best game for the Vita yet; an immersive, nostalgic 3-D platformer that'll leave Sly Cooper fans and noobs engaged alike. The graphics are gorgeous, the game play is intuitive, the script is witty, funny and not super cheesy like similar titles might be.
